title: Saliva sample transfer from source to target well plate
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Set temperature module
steps.instruction: If a temperature module with an aluminum block is present on the deck, set its temperature to the specified value in degrees Celsius before any liquid handling.

steps.title: Transfer saliva samples
steps.instruction: Using a 20 µL multi‑channel pipette, transfer 5 µL of saliva from each source well to the corresponding well of a 96‑well target plate, repeating for the specified number of samples and applying the user‑defined parameters: aspiration flow rate (µL/s), dispension flow rate (µL/s), aspiration height (mm) from the bottom of the source tubes, dispension height (mm) from the bottom of the target wells, and the wait time (s) after aspiration before withdrawing the tip.

substeps.instruction: Set the pipette to a 20 µL capacity.
Enter the number of samples to transfer.
Configure the aspiration flow rate (µL/s) as specified.
Configure the dispension flow rate (µL/s) as specified.
Position the pipette tip at the specified aspiration height (mm) above the bottom of each source tube.
Wait the specified amount of time (seconds) before withdrawing the tip.
Move the tip to the target well and position it at the specified dispension height (mm) above the bottom of the well.
Repeat the above steps for each of the remaining samples.
